metadata.title: Chip Bounce Back. They're Still Trading at a Discount.

content.text:
7 hours ago
Chip stocks rose, but were still on pace for double-digit losses for the week.
The PHLX Semiconductor Index was up 6.4% on Friday, but was still down over 10% for the week.
Among the week's worst performers were chipmakers such as Lumentum, which was on pace for a 34% decline. Marvell, Sandisk, and Ciena were all down more than 20% for the week despite surging today.
